data.title: Legitimate PaaS Subdomain Hosting Phishing Content
data.description: Detect URLs hosted on known PaaS free subdomain services (*.pages.dev, *.webflow.io, *.vercel.app, *.github.io, *.gitbook.io, *.workers.dev, *.r2.dev) that contain financial brand keywords or trigger phishing heuristics. These subdomains inherit the PaaS provider's domain reputation, bypassing domain-age and reputation filters commonly used in fraud detection.
falsepositives: Legitimate developer projects hosted on PaaS platforms
Documentation sites using brand names in context
Testing and staging environments on free-tier subdomains
